name: Rhys Williams
bio:
Rhys's fascination with motorsport began early, fueled by his father's involvement in local rally racing. He earned a degree in Electrical Engineering from the University of Auckland, focusing on embedded systems and control theory. After graduating, he spent several years honing his skills in the aerospace industry, working on flight control systems before transitioning to motorsport. His experience at the cutting edge of aerospace has given him a unique perspective on vehicle dynamics and data analysis.

Rhys joined a small Formula Ford team as their electronics engineer, quickly making a name for himself by developing innovative data logging and analysis tools. He is known for his meticulous approach to problem-solving, his ability to diagnose complex electrical issues with ease, and his dedication to continuous improvement. Rhys now seeks to leverage his expertise in a more demanding environment, where he can push the boundaries of what's possible with vehicle electronics and contribute to a winning team.

What sets Rhys apart is his ability to translate complex technical concepts into actionable insights for drivers and mechanics. He prioritizes clear communication and collaboration, ensuring that everyone on the team understands the role of electronics in achieving optimal performance. Rhys's dedication and innovative approach make him a valuable asset to any motorsport team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight wave
physical.description: Rhys is of average height, with a focused and observant demeanor.
